title: OH MY GOD (Meme)
blurb: Theatrical enough to carry an actual shock, and equally usable on a complete non-event, so the range here is enormous. Somebody has worn the same shirt twice in a week. The meeting has run one minute over. There is, catastrophically, no milk. All of these are now scandals of the first order. Every group chat needs a designated person who reacts like this to everything, and if yours does not have one, the button will fill the vacancy at no cost.
origin: A viral theatrical shock reaction clip.
